outcome: ASD disease severity (mild-moderate ASD, severe ASD)
cohort: The study included 128 children diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder and 100 control children, whose prenatal and perinatal characteristics were retrospectively evaluated.
finding: Paternal age and a history of hypoxia/asphyxia during pregnancy were significantly higher in the severe ASD group, while paternal smoking, preterm labor, and difficult delivery history were higher in both ASD groups compared to controls.
mod_finding: Difficult delivery history was found to be statistically higher in both ASD groups compared to the control group.
